scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof uses invariance, complete facet inequalities and the global concave John-ellipsoid optimization. Specific symbolic identities and feasible facet contacts are reproduced by an included standalone checker.
scientific_limitations: Only square complete-bipartite matching polytopes with the ambient Frobenius Euclidean metric, \(n\ge2\). The theorem identifies the maximal contained ellipsoid, not the enclosing ellipsoid or the volume of the polytope. Historical novelty is not proved conclusively; possible equivalent earlier formulations under optimal-design terminology remain. Finite checks are corroboration, not the proof. No independent assessment has been performed.
title: Exact John ellipsoid of the doubly substochastic matrix polytope
